name: grok-browser-relay
description: Relay between the Grok Browser extension and your own Grok Bot webhook routine (Cloudflare Worker + SQLite Durable Object).

EXT_TOKEN.description: A long random string (at least 24 characters) the extension sends. Generate one with `openssl rand -base64 32` or **Generate new tokens** on the setup wizard's *Deploy your relay* screen, and keep it: you paste it into the extension.

REPLY_TOKEN.description: A *different* long random string (at least 24 characters). Your Grok Bot uses it to post answers and fetch screenshots. Give it to your bot in the secure secret request named `GROK_BROWSER_REPLY_TOKEN`.

GROKBOT_WEBHOOK_URL.description: The **POST to** URL of the `Grok Browser` webhook routine. Copy it from your bot's **Routines** tab → **Grok Browser** → **Webhook** section.

GROKBOT_WEBHOOK_KEY.description: That routine's webhook **key**, from the same Webhook section (sent as `Authorization: Bearer`).
